summary.text: Alyson Sullivan-Almeida is a Republican state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 7th Plymouth District since January 2, 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Alyson Sullivan-Almeida assumed office in the 7th Plymouth District on January 2, 2019, succeeding Geoff Diehl.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her as ranking minority member of the House Committee on Intergovernmental Affairs and of the Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities Joint Committee, and as a member of the House Ways and Means Committee and the Education, Judiciary, and Ways and Means joint committees.
